description: This file defines an abstract class for testing relational database storage implementations within a .NET/Orleans project. It includes methods for setting up, tearing down, and managing databases and scripts for multiple database providers like SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL, facilitating integration testing across different database systems.

classes.name: RelationalStorageForTesting
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing different relational storage implementations. Handles database setup, teardown, and script execution across multiple database providers.

methods.name: SetupInstance
methods.description: Initializes and prepares a relational database environment for testing, including creation and setup of database schema.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Verifies the presence of a valid connection string associated with a specific invariant name, or skips the test if not available.

methods.name: CreateTestInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a relational storage based on invariant name and connection string.

methods.name: ExecuteSetupScript
methods.description: Runs setup scripts in sequence on the specified database for initialization.

methods.name: ExistsDatabaseAsync
methods.description: Checks whether a specified database exists.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseAsync
methods.description: Creates a new database with the given name.

methods.name: CopyInstance
methods.description: Creates a new storage instance with the same connection parameters but a different database name.
